name: bash
arguments:
{"command":"cd /workspace && python - <<'PY'
import ast
from src.component import calculate_black_area_doubled
source = open('tests.py').read()
ns = {}
exec(source.split('if __name__')[0], ns)
check_ast = ast.parse(source)
passed = 0
for line in open('tests.py'):
    if 'assert candidate(' not in line:
        continue
    test = ast.parse(line.strip()).body[0].test
    args = [ast.literal_eval(arg) for arg in test.left.args]
    expected = ast.literal_eval(test.comparators[0])
    actual = calculate_black_area_doubled(*args)
    if actual != expected:
        print(f'MISMATCH: {args}: spec result {actual}, fixture expects {expected}')
    else:
        passed += 1
print(f'{passed} assertions match')
PY"}
